enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (2) vs.reply: DIFFERENT: they measure different analytes and specimens, with Record A assaying plasma anti-SARS-CoV-2 RBD IgG/IgM/IgA and Record B assaying serum antibodies to OC43 and NL63 coronavirus RBD.

flow cytometry assay (2) vs flow cytomet.reply: DIFFERENT: Record A measures ex vivo PBMC immunophenotypic cell-population frequencies/marker-defined subsets, whereas Record B measures peptide-stimulated intracellular cytokine/cytotoxic molecule production (IFNγ, granzyme B, TNFα, IL-10) in CD8+ T cells.
